open_points.text: a function node ... whose contract version has no current_activation
open_points.question: What happens when a function node has no contract_version_id, an operation node has no binding_id, or both fields are populated?
open_points.default_guess: Raise StoreInternalError for malformed active flow data.

open_points.subject: start_run activation pinning
open_points.text: one PinnedImplementation per function node with the implementation of that current activation
open_points.question: Must the activation's contract_version_id equal node.contract_version_id, and must the referenced implementation be read and verified to belong to that contract?
options: Verify only the activation contract id
open_points.default_guess: Verify the activation and implementation both match the node's contract version.

open_points.subject: start_run stored-value identity
open_points.text: value_id and value_digest come from content_identity
open_points.question: Which IdentitySubject is used for value_digest, which for value_id, and whether put_value_bytes's return value must equal either is unspecified.
options: BytesContent for digest and StoredValueContent for value_id
JsonTextContent for digest and StoredValueContent for value_id
Use one content_identity result for both
open_points.default_guess: Use BytesContent for value_digest and StoredValueContent for value_id, and verify put_value_bytes returns the digest if applicable.

open_points.subject: start_run input schema
open_points.text: its value_schema, or for a many port the canonical array schema with it as items
open_points.question: What exact canonical schema encoding is required for many inputs?
options: Wrap parsed schema in a JSON Schema array object
Wrap the schema string without parsing
open_points.default_guess: Wrap the parsed item schema in a compact sorted-key array schema.

open_points.subject: start_run disclosure class
open_points.text: their StoredValues ... size and class
open_points.question: Which disclosure class is recorded when Port.disclosure_class is None?
open_points.default_guess: Default to open.

open_points.subject: start_run run identity
open_points.text: Runs are never deduplicated: two starts on equal inputs are two runs
open_points.question: How is a unique run_id generated when StartRunChange has no run_id field and no identifier generator is imported?
options: record_change generates the run_id and returns it
Include time or actor in an unstated identity computation
Use content_identity on StartRunChange despite deduplication requirement
open_points.default_guess: Assume record_change creates a fresh run identity and returns the created Run.

open_points.subject: start_run result selection
open_points.text: write one StartRunChange through record_change ... Then MUST advance the run
open_points.question: How is the newly created Run selected from the returned RecordSet when StartRunChange contains no run_id, especially if RecordSet contains other runs?
options: Require exactly one Run in the returned RecordSet
Diff against a pre-write run query
open_points.default_guess: Require record_change to return exactly the created Run.

open_points.subject: start_run timestamp reuse
open_points.text: with ... started_at
open_points.question: Is kernel_now called once and shared by StartRunChange and the resulting Run, and when relative to publishing inputs is it taken?
open_points.default_guess: Call once after all validation and input publication, immediately before constructing StartRunChange.

open_points.subject: start_run partial side effects
open_points.text: create no run on the first failure
open_points.question: If put_value_bytes succeeds for some inputs and a later publication or record_change fails, must those stored bytes be rolled back, or is only Run creation prohibited?
open_points.default_guess: Allow unreferenced content-addressed bytes to remain while ensuring no Run record is created.

open_points.subject: record_change result handling
open_points.text: Returns derive_run_answer of the run as it now rests or ended.
open_points.question: After each record_change, must functions use the Run returned in that RecordSet, re-read it by identity, or locally model the change?
open_points.default_guess: Use the unique updated Run in the returned RecordSet, falling back to a re-read only if the contract guarantees no Run there.

open_points.subject: PortRef and related unions
open_points.text: PortRef: imported runtime symbol; no local surface details available.
open_points.question: Which concrete variants belong to PortRef and ByteSource, how are they discriminated, and which fields may safely be read when orchestration requires dispatching between stored values and spooled files?
options: The listed StoredValuesRef and SpooledFilesRef are the complete union
Dispatch by concrete class rather than discriminator
open_points.default_guess: Assume PortRef is exactly StoredValuesRef | SpooledFilesRef and dispatch on ref_kind.

open_points.subject: ElementConclusion union
open_points.text: ElementConclusion: imported runtime symbol; no local surface details available.
open_points.question: Is ElementConclusion exactly the four listed conclusion models, and may conclusion_kind be used for exhaustive dispatch?
options: Exactly ElementNotReached, ElementSucceeded, ElementWaiting, and ElementFailed
open_points.default_guess: Assume the four listed models form the complete union and dispatch on conclusion_kind.

open_points.subject: RunOutput union
open_points.text: RunOutput: imported runtime symbol; no local surface details available.
open_points.question: Is RunOutput exactly ProducedOutput | MissingOutput, and are file outputs intentionally unsupported?
options: Additional file-output variant exists but is omitted
open_points.default_guess: Assume it is exactly ProducedOutput | MissingOutput and flow outputs must therefore be value-only.

open_points.subject: highest_disclosure_class
open_points.text: highest_disclosure_class(classes: tuple[DisclosureClass, ...])
open_points.question: Is the function defined for an empty tuple, and if so what class does it return?
open_points.default_guess: Assume it returns open.

open_points.subject: exception construction
open_points.text: raise RefusedError naming ... StoreInternalError ... UnknownReferenceError propagating
open_points.question: What constructor signatures and exact observable messages are required for locally raised RefusedError and StoreInternalError instances?
options: No message requirements beyond containing named values
open_points.default_guess: Use a single descriptive string containing every value the notes require to be named.
